requirements.name: App renders JSX
requirements.description: The App component renders JSX instead of a plain string.
requirements.hint: Return a JSX element from the component, e.g. <main>...</main>.

requirements.name: App shows a heading
requirements.description: The App component renders a heading with the text "Greeting App".
requirements.hint:
Add

Greeting App

to the rendered output.

requirements.name: Typing updates the input
requirements.description: Typing into the #name input updates the controlled component state.

requirements.name: Submitting the form greets the user
requirements.description: Submitting the form after typing a name shows "Hello <name>".
requirements.hint: Handle onSubmit on the form and render the message in #message.

requirements.name: Clicking the counter increments it
requirements.description: Clicking the #counter button increments the displayed count.
requirements.hint: Keep count in state and update it in the button's onClick handler.

requirements.name: Users load on mount
requirements.description: The Users component fetches /api/users when it mounts and renders the returned names.
requirements.hint: Call fetch in a useEffect with an empty dependency array.

requirements.name: Fetch mock serves the right data
requirements.description: The mocked /api/users route returns the declared body.
requirements.hint: The fetch assertion mocks the declared routes; the component must fetch that URL.

requirements.name: Project depends on React
requirements.description: The lab declares react and react-dom in its package.json dependencies.
requirements.hint: Add react and react-dom to the dependencies in package.json.

requirements.name: App component exists
requirements.description: The lab includes an App component that exports a function.
requirements.hint: Create src/App.jsx exporting a function component as default.

requirements.name: App uses an effect
requirements.description: The App component imports and calls useEffect.
requirements.hint: Import useEffect from react and call it inside the component, e.g. useEffect(() => { ... }, []).

requirements.name: Effects include a dependency array
requirements.description: Every useEffect call passes a dependency array as its second argument.
requirements.hint: Pass a second argument to useEffect, e.g. useEffect(() => { ... }, []) or useEffect(() => { ... }, [count]).

requirements.name: An effect returns a cleanup function
requirements.description: At least one effect in App returns a cleanup function.
requirements.hint: Return a function from the effect callback, e.g. useEffect(() => { ... return () => { ... }; }, []).

requirements.name: Custom hook exists
requirements.description: src/hooks/useCounter.js exports a use* function that calls React hooks.
requirements.hint: Create src/hooks/useCounter.js exporting a function named useCounter that calls at least one hook such as useState or useEffect.

requirements.name: App imports the expected modules
requirements.description: The App component imports react and the useCounter custom hook.
requirements.hint: Add import statements for react and ./hooks/useCounter.

requirements.name: Hook file exists
requirements.description: The custom hook file src/hooks/useCounter.js exists.

requirements.name: Hooks folder exists
requirements.description: The project has a src/hooks folder for custom hooks.
requirements.hint: Create the folder src/hooks and put custom hooks inside it.

requirements.name: About route exists
requirements.description: RoutedApp declares a route with the path /about.

requirements.name: Dynamic user route exists
requirements.hint: Add <Route path="/users/:id" element={...} /> and read the parameter with useParams().

requirements.name: About link exists
requirements.description: RoutedApp renders a Link or NavLink pointing at /about.
requirements.hint: Add <Link to="/about"> or <NavLink to="/about"> to the navigation.
